title: Materials Copay on Eyeglasses Orders by Patient Age and Channel — Vision Plans
content:
The materials copay of an eyeglasses order under the Vision Plans follows the patient and the channel:

| Channel | Patient under 19 on the date of service | Patient 19 or over |
|---|---|---|
| Participating location (independent practice or retail chain) | The plan's materials copay multiplied by 0.5 | The plan's materials copay |
| Out of network | None (0.00) | None (0.00) |

The patient's age is counted in whole years from the enrollee's date of birth to the date of service; 19 is the child age limit. The plan's materials copay is 0.00 on Cascade Vision Exam Plus, 25.00 on Essential 100 and Select 130, 20.00 on Select 150 and Choice 175, and 0.00 on Premier 200.

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** For a patient born on 11 January, an order on 10 January of the 19th birthday year is for a patient under 19: on Cascade Vision Select 130 the materials copay is 12.50. An order on 11 January is for a 19-year-old, and the copay is 25.00.
